<translate>
<!--T:1-->
'''Masters''' are the trainer NPCs of DragonMineZ. Most of them teach [[Special:MyLanguage/Skills|skills]] and [[Special:MyLanguage/Techniques|techniques]] in exchange for [[Special:MyLanguage/Training Points and Mastery|Training Points]], five of them run a [[Special:MyLanguage/Training Minigames|training minigame]], and several offer services such as healing, weighted gear or a Flying Nimbus. Right-click a master to open the NPC dialogue: one menu with everything that master offers.
</translate>

<div class="dmz-cards">
{{Card|Master Roshi|<translate><!--T:2--> The basics: Jump, Meditation, Ki Control, the Kamehameha and weighted Turtle Shells.</translate>}}
{{Card|Krillin|<translate><!--T:3--> Ki skills, the Kienzan and Solar Flare, and the Ki Control minigame.</translate>}}
{{Card|Goku|<translate><!--T:4--> Fly, Instant Transmission, the Fusion Dance and the Spirit Bomb.</translate>}}
{{Card|Gohan|<translate><!--T:5--> Ki Boost, Ki Protection, Ki Sense and the Shadow Boxing minigame.</translate>}}
{{Card|Piccolo|<translate><!--T:6--> Potential Unlock, the Special Beam Cannon, healing and weighted capes.</translate>}}
{{Card|Vegeta|<translate><!--T:7--> The Galick Gun, Final Flash, Fake Moon and the Gravity minigame.</translate>}}
{{Card|Trunks|<translate><!--T:8--> Ki skills, sword strikes and the Precision minigame.</translate>}}
{{Card|Yamcha|<translate><!--T:9--> Ki Infusion, the Spirit Ball and the Wolf Fang.</translate>}}
{{Card|Master Tien|<translate><!--T:185--> The Dodon Ray, the Tri-Beam and the Neo Tri-Beam, on the World Martial Arts Tournament island.</translate>}}
{{Card|Majin Buu|<translate><!--T:10--> Assault Rain, Gum Punch, Mystic Ball Attack and Sleep Recovery.</translate>}}
{{Card|Fortuneteller Baba|<translate><!--T:11--> Basic skills and a tournament on Earth; revivals in the Otherworld.</translate>}}
{{Card|Korin|<translate><!--T:12--> The Flying Nimbus and Senzu Beans.</translate>}}
{{Card|Mr. Popo|<translate><!--T:13--> Haircuts at the Lookout and the Rhythm minigame in the Time Chamber.</translate>}}
{{Card|Dende|<translate><!--T:14--> Healing, character resets, tails and Kami's Blessing.</translate>}}
{{Card|Dr. Gero|<translate><!--T:15--> Turns Humans into Androids.</translate>}}
{{Card|Babidi|<translate><!--T:16--> Gives the Majin mark to Evil-aligned players.</translate>}}
{{Card|Cell|<translate><!--T:17--> A huge roster of skills and techniques, for Evil-aligned players only.</translate>}}
{{Card|Frieza|<translate><!--T:18--> Death Beams, the Supernova and many skills, for Evil-aligned players only.</translate>}}
{{Card|Grand Elder Guru|<translate><!--T:19--> Unlocks Potential Unlock level 11.</translate>}}
{{Card|Old Kai|<translate><!--T:20--> The Soul Punisher and the Ultimate Challenge.</translate>}}
{{Card|King Kai|<translate><!--T:21--> The Kaioken, the Spirit Bomb and Workout Weights.</translate>}}
{{Card|King Yemma|<translate><!--T:22--> Sends spirits back to the living world.</translate>}}
{{Card|Grand Kai|<translate><!--T:23--> The way to the Otherworld Tournament.</translate>}}
</div>

[[Special:MyLanguage/Fortuneteller Baba|Fortuneteller Baba]] (on Earth) and [[Special:MyLanguage/Cell|Cell]] also host [[Special:MyLanguage/Tournaments|tournaments]].
</translate>

<translate>
== Alignment == <!--T:80-->
</translate>
{{See also|Alignment}}
<translate>
<!--T:81-->
Some masters only train you if your [[Special:MyLanguage/Alignment|alignment]] fits (bands: '''Good 61–100''', '''Neutral 41–60''', '''Evil 0–40'''):
* '''Good-aligned masters''': [[Special:MyLanguage/Master Roshi|Master Roshi]], Krillin, Goku, Gohan, Old Kai and King Kai need an alignment of 61 or higher.
* '''Evil-aligned masters''': Cell and Frieza need an alignment of 40 or lower.
* '''Every other master''' has no alignment requirement by default.
</translate>

<translate>
<!--T:82-->
Every master and quest NPC talks to you, whatever your alignment; if it dislikes you (wrong alignment, or hostile toward you), it greets you with a cold line instead. A master whose alignment you don't fit keeps '''Skills''' and '''Train''' locked ("Requires an alignment of 61 or higher." or "40 or lower.") until your alignment fits. The '''Quests''' option is always open: only quests whose giver needs another alignment show as locked (saga quests and quests with an alignment condition of their own follow their own rules), and quests you already started or can turn in stay usable. Their other services and tournaments stay open. A few services have alignment rules of their own (Korin's Nimbus, Dende's blessing, [[Special:MyLanguage/Grand Elder Guru|Grand Elder Guru]], Babidi, Old Kai's challenge); they're listed on each master's page.
</translate>

<translate>
<!--T:83-->
Whether NPCs are hostile toward you is a separate, configurable system (see [[Special:MyLanguage/NPC Placement and Alignment|NPC Placement and Alignment]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== Talking to a master == <!--T:84-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:85-->
Right-clicking a master (or a quest NPC such as Bulma) opens the dialogue at the bottom of the screen: the NPC on the left, what they say in the middle and your options on the right. You need to have created your character first.
</translate>

{| class="wikitable"
! <translate><!--T:86--> Option</translate> !! <translate><!--T:87--> Who has it</translate> !! <translate><!--T:88--> What it does</translate>
|-
| <translate><!--T:89--> '''Quests'''</translate> || <translate><!--T:90--> NPCs that give quests</translate> || <translate><!--T:91--> Lists their quests in the order they unlock in the story: available, in progress, ready to turn in and locked ones. Completed quests (greyed out, with a check mark) and repeatable quests on cooldown move to the bottom. Pick a quest to see its description, objectives and rewards, then '''Accept''' or '''Reject''' it, or '''Turn in''' a finished one; the window stays open. Once every quest of that NPC is done, the '''Quests''' option shows a check mark.</translate>
|-
| <translate><!--T:92--> '''Skills'''</translate> || <translate><!--T:93--> Every master who teaches</translate> || <translate><!--T:94--> Opens the master's skill shop (see ''What masters teach'' below).</translate>
|-
| <translate><!--T:95--> '''Train'''</translate> || <translate><!--T:96--> Every master who teaches (Mr. Popo only inside the Time Chamber)</translate> || <translate><!--T:97--> '''Shadow Clone''' spawns a Shadow Dummy copy of you to spar with; masters with a [[Special:MyLanguage/Training Minigames|training minigame]] also list it here.</translate>
|-
| <translate><!--T:98--> ''Services''</translate> || <translate><!--T:99--> Some masters and NPCs</translate> || <translate><!--T:100--> See ''Services'' below.</translate>
|-
| <translate><!--T:101--> '''Tournament'''</translate> || <translate><!--T:102--> Fortuneteller Baba (Earth), Cell, the [[Special:MyLanguage/Otherworld Tournament Announcer|Otherworld Tournament Announcer]], the World Tournament Announcer ([[Special:MyLanguage/World Martial Arts Tournament|World Martial Arts Tournament]])</translate> || <translate><!--T:103--> Opens the tournament screen. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Tournaments|Tournaments]].</translate>
|}

<translate>
<!--T:104-->
* An option you can't use right now stays in the list but '''locked''': hover it to see why (wrong alignment, a skill level that's too low, a Flying Nimbus you already carry, full health and so on). Some masters answer in character when you click a locked service.
* Options with a cooldown (Korin's Senzu Beans, Kami's Blessing, Baba's revive, repeatable quests) show a '''timer''' that counts down live; the option unlocks by itself when it runs out.
* After a service the master replies and the window stays open. Teleports ([[Special:MyLanguage/King Yemma|King Yemma]], the [[Special:MyLanguage/Grand Kai|Grand Kai]], the [[Special:MyLanguage/Otherworld Tournament Announcer|Tournament Announcer]]), Dende's stat reset and the Shadow Clone close it.
* A locked quest tells you what's missing, for example which saga quest or sidequest to complete first.
</translate>

<translate>
<!--T:105-->
'''Controls:''' click an option, use {{Key|↑}} / {{Key|↓}} and {{Key|Enter}}, or press {{Key|1}}–{{Key|9}}. Click the text (or press {{Key|Space}} or {{Key|Enter}}) to show the whole line at once. '''Back''' ({{Key|Backspace}} or right click) returns to the previous page; '''Close''' or {{Key|Esc}} leaves.
</translate>

<translate>
== What masters teach == <!--T:106-->
</translate>
{{Config|Skills Config|skillOfferings}}
<translate>
<!--T:107-->
Techniques are split into '''ki attacks''' (ranged energy), '''strike attacks''' (melee) and '''evasion techniques''' (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Techniques|Techniques]]). Plain '''skills''' are passive or utility unlocks (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Skills|Skills]]). You pay for them with Training Points. Your [[Special:MyLanguage/Races|race]] still has to allow each skill, so a master's shop only lists the skills your race can learn; techniques are always listed, but a few of them can only be equipped by one race (marked below). These are the default lists:
</translate>

{{Note|type=config|title=<translate><!--T:154--> Server settings</translate>|<translate><!--T:155--> What each master teaches is set in <code>config/dragonminez/skills.json</code> (<code>skillOfferings</code>, one list per master id), and the minigames in <code>training.json</code>. A master without a list of its own uses the <code>default</code> list (Ki Control and Jump).</translate>}}

<translate>
== Training == <!--T:156-->
</translate>
{{Main|Training Minigames}}
<translate>
<!--T:157-->
Every master who teaches also has a '''Train''' option. '''Shadow Clone''' spawns a Shadow Dummy copy of you to spar with. Five masters also run a training minigame there: [[Special:MyLanguage/Krillin|Krillin]] (Ki Control), [[Special:MyLanguage/Gohan|Gohan]] (Shadow Boxing), [[Special:MyLanguage/Trunks|Trunks]] (Precision), [[Special:MyLanguage/Vegeta|Vegeta]] (Gravity) and [[Special:MyLanguage/Mr. Popo|Mr. Popo]] (Rhythm, inside the Time Chamber). [[Special:MyLanguage/Old Kai|Old Kai]]'s '''Unleash Power''' service chains all five into the Ultimate Challenge.
</translate>

<translate>
== Services == <!--T:158-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:159-->
Besides teaching, several masters (and the other NPCs living next to them) offer services as options of their dialogue:

<translate>
<!--T:178-->
'''Weighted Gear''' (Roshi, King Kai, Piccolo) can be asked for once per conversation; talk to them again for more. Healing services are locked when you're already at full health, and don't work while you're knocked out after a temporary revive.
</translate>

{{Config|General Server Config}}
<translate>
<!--T:179-->
The amounts above are server defaults: the Senzu gift (<code>senzuGiftAmount</code>, <code>senzuGiftCooldownTicks</code>), Kami's Blessing (the <code>kamiBless…</code> settings) and the maximum weight you can request (<code>maxWeightRequested</code>, 100,000 kg by default) can all be changed.
</translate>

<translate>
== Other NPCs == <!--T:180-->
</translate>
<translate>
=== Toribot === <!--T:181-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:182-->
On King Kai's Planet in the Otherworld, right next to [[Special:MyLanguage/King Kai|King Kai]], stands '''Toribot''', a little easter egg for fans. He isn't a master: he teaches nothing and has no services or quests. Talk to him and he greets you with one of his lines ("Beep boop! I am Toribot, thanks for visiting me!"), chatting about doodling new characters and claiming he drew this whole universe himself.
</translate>

<translate>
=== Hosts and quest NPCs === <!--T:183-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:184-->
* The '''[[Special:MyLanguage/Otherworld Tournament Announcer|Otherworld Tournament Announcer]]''' hosts the [[Special:MyLanguage/Otherworld Tournament|Otherworld Tournament]] and sends you back to the Grand Kai.
* The '''World Tournament Announcer''' hosts the [[Special:MyLanguage/World Martial Arts Tournament|World Martial Arts Tournament]] on its island.
